from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    """A single financial line item extracted from the filing's relevant tables."""
    label: str = Field(description="The name of the line item as written in the document (e.g., 'Net profits income', 'Net cash used in operating activities')")
    value: float | None = Field(description="The numeric amount reported for this item")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale of the amount, e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    category: str = Field(description="The section or type of this metric (e.g., 'Operating Activities', 'Trust Specific Income', 'Balance Sheet')")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim snippet from the document anchoring this metric")

class FinancialFiling(BaseModel):
    """A parsed financial filing (e.g., 10-Q) containing performance data."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="The name of the company the filing belongs to")
    period_end: str = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period")
    has_statement_of_cash_flows: bool = Field(description="Whether the document includes a formal Statement of Cash Flows section")
    metrics: list[FinancialMetric] = Field(description="List of relevant financial metrics extracted from the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    filings: list[FinancialFiling]
